findings.message: 1 input parameter(s) become dbt vars and notebook widgets.
SET NOCOUNT is a SQL Server session setting with no Databricks equivalent; dropped.
Current time: SQL Server returns the server's local time; Databricks returns the session time zone (UTC unless configured).
ISNULL becomes COALESCE. ISNULL returns the type of its first argument (and can truncate the fallback value); COALESCE uses type precedence.
Delta UPDATE/DELETE has no FROM/JOIN clause; rewritten as MERGE INTO with the join as the source. If the join matches a target row more than once, SQL Server picks one silently but Delta MERGE fails.
